name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2472: prune.arm was the last of the five self-arming locks with evidence left to gather, and it sat at n=0 UNPROVEN - nobody had attempted anything against it. prune_wilson attempts 42 states in which retention_may_act must refuse: every spelling of OFF (v2082s scar, where the switch matched the byte 0 alone and off, false, no, OFF and 0-with-a-space all armed an unattended deleter), an unconfirmed board world, a world check that raises, and a drift answer of the wrong shape. All 42 refused, wilson 0.916 against a bar of 0.839. The lock still reads LOCKED, and that is the design rather than a shortfall: kinds_bar is 1.8 and sabotage weighs 1.0, so the one door with no undo does not open on a single kind of look. The harness calls exactly one function, whose own docstring is decides never acts, and refuses at write time to set the switch to anything that is not a spelling of OFF.
